entries.summary: C158 (5): a column's width from the keyboard -- the table stays one Tab stop, the arrows walk the heads (a head with an edge and no sort button is a stop itself), Enter, Shift+F10, the menu key or the right button on a head with an edge opens «Изменить ширину · По содержимому · По умолчанию»; «Изменить ширину» takes the focus to the edge, whose arrows set the width through SIMAI Framework SF.Resizer.attach (sf-resizer 1.3.0), Enter or Escape go back to the head; «По содержимому» fits the column to its head and values on one line, kept as the person's width; «По умолчанию» drops it, as a double click on the edge still does. The edge's name and value («27 %») are words of the language files. Space on a sort button still sorts.

entries.consumer: Nothing to change for a host: copy-link and open-full beside the close are the page's small buttons.
entries.summary: In its panel (C205 (2); ui-pro f29d4bf taken back, so ui-view is the one home of the component): (1) when sf-drawer brings the edge controls into its head's row (data-sf-drawer-edge-in-head: a phone, size full, or no room beside the panel), copy-link and open-full are the page's buttons beside the close: size 1/3 (they were the panel's size, 36-40 next to a 24-28 close), without the raised popup plate, in a row 8 apart; the wrapper no longer keeps a column there. The view follows the drawer's attribute (it measures), and draws the controls anew when their place changes. Beside a wide panel they are unchanged. (2) A filled panel whose edge stands in the drawer's head starts its head on the panel's axis and stops --sf-space-1/3 short of the drawer's --sf-drawer-edge-room: still padded for a strip at its start, the record's name ran under the controls at 390. 1.16.4 here is VP-5/VP-8; ui-pro's own 1.16.1, 1.16.2 and 1.16.4 are its patched copies, superseded by this version. Markup, settings, events and the host port unchanged.

entries.summary: In its panel (VP-5, VP-8 of the 2026-11-16 re-check; C157 (3), C157 (7) = C159 (4), (5)): (1) the title reads the window title step the drawer's panel publishes, --sf-drawer--title-size / --sf-drawer--title-height (sf-drawer 1.16.4), before the h4 role: the head stands inside the drawer's body, where sf-drawer 1.16.0 moves the heading roles down for the content, and the title drew 16/18 (a phone 14/16) instead of 20/24 (16). --sf-property-view--title-* still come first; with no drawer, or a drawer before 1.16.4, the h4 role as before. (2) On a phone (below 48rem) Save (or Create) and Cancel in the foot share the row in equal halves, 8 apart, the main one first; what else the bar holds wraps under them. The desktop foot is unchanged. Markup, settings, events and the host port unchanged.
